findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/config.ts:226 the pre-existing capability_release_* global-phase wildcard is commented as read-only non-runtime product capability release provenance inspection and previously only matched the two read-only commands capability_release_list/capability_release_status. The new capability_release_backfill handler (packages/main/src/handlers/capability-release-backfill.ts) - a mainSharedMutating writer that git-commits ledger records and enriches playbook lineage under a learning-store lock - also matches this prefix and is silently granted allowedPhases:all through it (verified: isCommandAllowed(capability_release_backfill, phase) returns true for every phase via this wildcard, not via a dedicated entry). Every other allowedPhases:all mainSharedMutating command in this file (e.g. signature_backfill line 284, learning_scan line 290) gets its own explicit comment stating the phase-scope rationale per the files established convention; this new writer instead free-rides on a wildcard whose adjacent comment is now stale/inaccurate (no longer purely read-only inspection). Not a functional block (command works as intended), but an audit-trail/maintainability gap: a future reader auditing config.ts * -phase writers by comment would miss this one.
findings.resolvedReason: Added a dedicated self-documenting capability_release_backfill entry in config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS (intentionally all-phase MUTATING migration writer, matching signature_backfill/learning_scan); behavior unchanged (all phases).

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: lattice.config.json (whole file) - this diff reformats the entire file from compact single-line JSON array/object entries to fully expanded multi-line JSON (e.g. the validate.commands and doneRequiredCommands arrays), and also drops the files trailing newline (confirmed: `git show main:lattice.config.json | tail -c5` ends in `}\n`; the worktree HEAD version ends in `}` with no trailing newline). This is unrelated reformatting noise bundled into a story whose actual config change is only 3 new lines appended to validate.commands (the 3 new smoke paths) plus the capability_release_backfill catalog/policy registrations elsewhere. It inflates the reviewable diff (126 changed lines in a file where the substantive change is 3 lines) and creates spurious merge-conflict surface for any other in-flight story touching lattice.config.json.
findings.resolvedReason: Restored lattice.config.json from main + added only the 3 smoke entries; minimal diff, trailing newline preserved.
